purpose: Compare new public material with the saved August Q1/guidance basis and later September notice headlines without silently treating historical per-share or consolidation bases as current.

sections: Step2 key financial/operational metrics and forward guidance
author_method_references.project_adaptation: Track issuer actuals, annual guidance, metrics and strategic changes with explicit periods/units/perimeter. No missing consensus, forecast, scenario/stock reaction or financial threshold is supplied.
Keep original questions separate from supporting/disconfirming subsequent observations; adapt at least quarterly to an internal research date without creating a financial thesis.

Public evidence first: retain answered facts, compare definition differences, and check unread saved material before considering a residual. No private-equity information requests, meeting lengths or automatic questions are imported.

reading_scope.homepage: Saved visible business/notice headlines only; notice bodies not obtained.

review_questions.established_scope: Q1 consolidated actual cumulative2026-04-01–2026-06-30: revenue14,276/OP553/parent NI364 in million JPY summary, truncated below million. Prior comparableQ1 is separate. Detailed p7 PL uses thousand JPY and distinct operating/nonoperating/special/tax lines; prior fixed-asset gain183,609 thousand has current dash. Issuer FY2026-04-01–2027-03-31 forecast64,000/3,700/5,300 million is unchanged from2026-05-13 as stated2026-08-06. Annual management is the publicly stated reason for omitting interim guidance.
review_questions.future_review: Compare future actual cumulative duration with the corresponding prior duration, separately from annual issuer forecast and its prior version; retain operating vs ordinary vs parent profit and each table unit. Examine an actual new issuer explanation of the operating/NI bridge rather than inferring it from the Q1 rows. Keep quarter-only vs cumulative and prior-year vs prior-guidance comparison distinct.
review_questions.do_not_infer: Do not annualize Q1, change a dash to0, treat FX/asset gains as operating improvement or normalCF, allocate an unexplained annual NI forecast to an invented one-off, or call a carried Q1 item in later cumulative results a recurrence. Tax/CF/model fit and whole-book reading remain unverified.

review_questions.established_scope: The AugustQ1 statement distinguishes company totals/EPS and period-end/average shares, with stock-compensation trust shares included in the relevant treasury-share deductions. Saved homepage has a2026-09-10 stock-split/bylaw/shareholder-benefit/dividend-forecast-revision notice headline, but the linked notice body is not obtained.
review_questions.future_review: If an eligible actual notice or later statement is saved, check its explicit publication/target/effective dates, split ratio, share/trust convention and EPS/DPS comparison basis before updating what is current. Keep the August historical basis as historical and any revised per-share basis separately sourced.
review_questions.do_not_infer: Headline date is not split effective date or proof of implementation. Split ratio/revised DPS are unknown. Do not adjust historical EPS a second time, reconstruct EPS from company totals, reuse August EPS/DPS/share count as the current October basis, or imply a share-price action.

review_questions.established_scope: Statement2 says no material consolidation change within the Q1 cumulative period and that quarter-specific accounting treatment applies; detailed treatment remains unread. Statement4 discloses three growth strategies and regional results. Homepage has a2026-09-30 Unity acquisition/subsidiary notice headline; body not obtained.
review_questions.future_review: Compare explicit new public perimeter, acquisition timing/accounting/contribution and strategic commentary against the same entity/period definitions. Check saved unread notes/CF/orders before labeling details an unanswered IR issue. Record newly confirmed definitions and residual gaps separately.
review_questions.do_not_infer: Q1 no-material-change is not current group-scope assurance. A subsidiary notice headline is not proof of completion/date/price/goodwill/contribution or organic growth. Region/strategy labels and quarterly treatment flag do not establish cashflow/normal profits or financial applicability.

comparison_protocol.supports: Only actual explicit new evidence can support a tracked definition/relationship on its stated period/entity/unit/share basis.
comparison_protocol.counterevidence: Record an actual public correction or contradiction to a specific saved observation; do not invent a numerical falsification condition.
comparison_protocol.unchanged: Newly reviewed material may leave the tracked historical definitions unchanged without completing financial valuation.
comparison_protocol.unresolved: Unread, absent or ambiguous evidence remains unresolved; no response/unclear information is not deterioration, zero, success probability or a sell signal.

already_answered_not_to_reask: Q1 display values and their periods/units/OP-vs-NI distinction
August forecast unchanged and public reason for omitted interim forecast
Q1 no-material-scope-change and stock-trust share definitions
Public PL nonoperating/special-line presentation and stated growth strategies

later_notice_limits.implication: August per-share guidance/share count cannot be assumed current, split ratio/effective date and revised DPS unknown
Q1 no-material-change statement does not certify current group perimeter or acquisition contribution

management_review.purpose: internal research management only, not an issuer event or sale/holding deadline

IR_boundary: No draft/branch/question/send readiness. Unread saved material or unobtained linked notice text is not proof of company nonresponse. Recheck public answers before a new question; normal tax/valuation assumptions and future guarantees are not questions for the issuer.
closed_route_boundary: No new GET or automatically reopened finite route; original snapshots and chronology stay unchanged. New source means genuinely new saved evidence, not repackaged additional page reading.
unadopted: completed acquisition or current group perimeter/contribution
issuer event/sale/falsification date and external sending
